title: Full filesystem and local workstation parity under Full Control
draft_note: Activation-ready draft under prep/ (revision 6). P20-reserved id and role 'full_filesystem_and_workstation_parity' (docs/p20/sg000092_architecture_freeze.json); activated out of the recorded sequential order by founder decision FD-UP-4 of 2026-11-17. It becomes active only when the activation PR (WP1-00) copies it into .specgrain/specs/ with this field removed and updates apps/orcel-mcp/src/p20-architecture.test.ts.

dependency_notes.SG-000132: The authority service and dispatcher admit every Full Control filesystem, process and application action; standing approvals cover declared task scopes.

objective: Under a Full User lease on Windows, give complete user-level filesystem and workstation parity across the drives and roots the user authorizes at grant: read, write, create, copy, move, rename, recursive operations, large and binary files, deletion to the Recycle Bin by default (permanent deletion only by explicit request and its own approval), metadata, search; process listing, inspection and termination of the user's processes; application launch, activation and close; git beyond workspaces through the existing provider; and clipboard through the existing provider. Path identity and result semantics stay as strict as in Safe mode (canonical paths, reparse-point and alternate-data-stream rules, race detection). Every action is dispatched through SG-000132 and audited; the Orcel authority state is outside reach by construction, and the user-session Orcel state root is refused for writes. Spec sections 4.14 and 8.2 (WP1-15).

include: Filesystem provider operations under a lease, limited to the lease's authorized roots, with Safe-mode path identity rules.
Recycle Bin deletion by default; permanent deletion only by explicit request with its own approval (never covered by a standing approval unless the standing approval names it).
Process inspection and termination for processes of the same user; application launch and close, each launched tree in a Job Object registered with the service.
Large-file and binary transfer with bounded chunks and digests.
Tests on Windows native runners; J-3b.
exclude: Elevation, other users' processes or files, system-protected locations needing administrator rights (SG-000098).

authority_delta.filesystem: Proposed: Full User filesystem, process and application authority within authorized roots, admitted per dispatch by the authority service.

decisions.question: Scope of control
decisions.status: DECIDED (FD-UP-9): comprehensive control including filesystem across authorized drives, processes and application management.

invariants: No filesystem action outside the lease's authorized roots.
Path identity, reparse-point, alternate-data-stream and race rules are not weaker than in Safe mode.
Deletion goes to the Recycle Bin unless permanent deletion is explicitly requested and separately approved.
Every action has a service Authorize and audit record first.
No action touches another user's processes or files, or requires elevation.
acceptance: Each operation works across two authorized drives on the Windows runner and is refused outside them.
Junction, symlink, ADS and race attacks are refused as in Safe mode.
Deletion lands in the Recycle Bin; permanent deletion needs its own approval.
Process termination is limited to the user's processes; launched applications are visible and usable and are killed by stop.
A fresh-context security judge passes the packet.
